title: Amelia | Hooded Cardigan You'll Reach For All Year
bodyHtml:
The cardigan that works as hard as you do—throw it on over a tee or dress when you need warmth, wear it solo on warmer days, and never think twice. From cool mornings to mild afternoons, this versatile layer adapts to your day and your climate without fuss. Soft, skimming and honestly just the piece you'll find yourself coming back to again and again.

Why you'll love it

  • Perfect layering piece when temperatures drop—adds warmth without weighing you down
  • Effortless to slip over a top, blouse or lightweight jumper for instant cosiness
  • Soft and breathable, comfortable from morning to night—at home, at work, out and about
  • Sits beautifully without clinging, so you stay relaxed all day
  • Works with everything—jeans, trousers, dresses, skirts—open or buttoned
  • Hooded design adds a casual, laid-back feel to any outfit
  • Limited stock from our special Anniversary Collection—once it's gone, it's gone

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
